effects.display_name: Arachnoid native lunge, float, ranged and anchor source controller
effects.actual_behavior: Alive tick uses a once-read Mob target snapshot and integer-truncated Euclidean store_target_distance. Before primed controller, mode!=4 and integerDistance in1..7 and not CrawlingY>245 writes ABSOLUTE repulsion XZ=(self-target)/integerDistance*.3 clamped each to[-20,20], retaining Y. DATA_primed gates modes. Mode1 lunge_time<=0: target nonnull resets600; raw noai_reset cleared. Positive timer with distance<=20 and landingClock<=398 clears noai_reset; else at599 with target refreshes distance, and nonzero .5*integerDistance stores (target-self)/(.3*integerDistance), Y numerator targetY+.5; stores own XYZ and reversal flags, which are not consumed by this helper. Low health<Max/2 at390 writes timer10 before later windows. Timer>540: subwindow<580 with storedX and storedZ both nonzero writes clamped stored XZ/currentY; if target, at560 recalculates stored XZ with existing integerDistance (no new zero guard), then server InvincibilityTemp10/0 and Strength20/1. ARPHEX_GRIEFING AND native MobGriefing AND timer%7==0 AND Health>50 requests server NULL-source MOB explosion7 at currentXYZ,Y+2; independently queues1 current actor Y=-.1 retaining currentXZ, no delivery state/alive check. Window sets noai_reset=true; outside clears it. Timer>540 and nonzero .6*distance independently requests Strength5/1 after earlier Strength20/1; native merge decides result. Positive lunge timer is decremented1 after its body. Mode2 increments float_time first; flash<=0 requests InvincibilityTemp20/0 and lowHealth plus UPDATEDfloatTime>40 plus target emits five ChronoShot native arrows, then flash10; otherwise decrementsflash1. Mode2 target-null disables noPhysics/chrono_effects; target present: updatedTime<40 sets absolute(0,1.5,0), enables chrono_effects/noPhysics, sets onGroundfalse, and integerDistance>8 overrides with clamped 3D (target+(0,11,0)-self)/integerDistance*.3. Mode3 target present crouches; flash<=0 resets20 and emits same five ChronoShot arrows; else flash-1. Both volleys use actor owner, floatbase5,KB1,BYTE0,silenttrue,pos currentX/Y+3.4/Z, shoot speed1/0 with vectors [0,0,0],[-.3,.3,0],[.3,.3,0],[0,.3,.3],[0,.3,-.3]; native shoot normalizes nonzero vectors. Mode4 always zeros XZ/currentY and requests Slowness5/999, even target-null; flash<=0, target snapshot and attackSwitchTime>100 queue60, resetflash60. Delivery current-level server creates SpacetimeAnchor owneractor, base5/KB1/BYTE0/silenttrue,currentX/eyeY-.1/Z/currentlook speed1/0. Nested5 delays give deliveries60/65/70. ONLY at third delivery, currentHealth<Max/2 admits three more nested5 deliveries75/80/85. No later primed/mode/target/alive/original-world checks; nested queues proceed even if server spawn branch skips. Other modes with target: flash<=0/onGround/noTimeClone full-side50 requests MobSummoned clone at flooredcurrentposition and copies rotations, NOownerassignment; flash200. Other positiveflash-1. Mode!=1 resetslunge0. Mode!=2 resetsfloatTime0 and chrono_effectsfalse; non-VOID_AIR and notinwall clears noPhysics, else absolute(0,.5,0)/noPhysics true. Non3 clearscrouch. LandingClock<400 increments1; lowHealth and lunge in4..299 writes1 afterward. Finally passedworldserver attackSwitchTime>0 decrements1; else reset300 and computes bounded five-mode shuffle. ShuffleNumber<=1 resets5, samples unique numbers1..5 for at most100 trials (not guaranteed complete), else decreases1. Native DecimalFormat/string replace extraction and Double.parseDouble(trim) with exception=>0 set integercurrent_final, which may use fallback clone branch. Mode update is AFTER attack arms but BEFORE temporal aura. Cosmetic flash texture/animation, unused storedY/reversal reads here, and particle-only cannon_cycle/angle_increment are not independent numeric contributions.

effects.display_name: Arachnoid native escalating time field and local damage/motion aura
effects.actual_behavior: FIRST alive primed+rawchrono_effects arm uses PREUPDATE float_time>40 and modulo4==0. Entity query currentXYZ inflated (24+float_expand*2)/2 then strict Euclidean radius<12+float_expand, excludes only ArachnoidTrisector type, no team/creative/ArmorStand filter. Living recipient existingTimeFreezeamp(default0)<20 requests server TimeFreeze60/(currentamp+1), ambient/visiblefalse, ignored effect result: absent starts1, native admission/merge retained. AFTER query, positivefloatTime>180 changes expansion +1 through240, -1 when>240; <=180 resets0. Expansion has no clamp; 15+expand sphere geometry is presentation only, whereas 12+expand is actual fieldradius. Neither geometry/cannon_cycle nor angle_increment is the damage aura radius. After mode/controller/health/servermode updates, INDEPENDENT alive Entityinflate10 at original callbackXYZ, distance sorted. Excludes ChronoShot,AscendantArrow,SpacetimeAnchor,Arachnoid,ItemEntity and recipient rawcreativespectator. If recipient type is native minecraft:impact_projectiles OR WebbedArrow OR BloodProjectile: absolute(0,-.1,0) irrespective actor invincibility or rawslowtime; it is not a damage/status request. Other recipients: UPDATEDmode==2, CURRENTMobtargetnonnull, LivingnotArmorStand and UPDATEDflash==5 requests anonymous MAGIC maxRecipientHealth/5 with NO direct/causing source entity, hurt result ignored. This request is BEFORE checking ACTOR InvincibilityTemp; invincible actor can still request damage but then skips the ordinary damping arm. Noninvincible actor and (rawslowtime==5 OR recipient notPlayer): nativeY *=.5 only above absY threshold. No-target or non-current-target use .003; currenttarget .006. XZ *=.25 if either axis exceeds threshold .00045 for ordinary vs .001 for currenttarget. Y preserved in XZ write, XZ preserved in Y write; requests can occur without hurt success. No spherical distance gate here: inflate10 cubic box only, no primed/mode gate for movement, no added team/owner predicate. Native impact_projectiles membership is a pack-resolved admission gate rather than guessed exact members; excluded/custom projectile lifecycle contracts are reused.

effects.display_name: Arachnoid native tick retention, priming and environment control
effects.actual_behavior: Nonnull native actor: all main helper behavior requires isAlive. First removes Levitation, Weakness, Slowness, Necrosis, TimeFreeze, Paralysis, Repulsion, Supergravity and Webbed from Living actor, without a server guard. Absent Regeneration requests server duration60/amplifier0, ambient=false,visible=false. DWELLER_HEALTH and currentHealth>60 writes native health60; DWELLERS_INCLUSION=false writes/syncs map last_despawn_reasons=arachnoid-bosses-disabled then current-server discard, WITHOUT returning from helper. Near end, raw health_loss_limit minus10 > currentHealth: only if currentHealth>0 native setHealth(float(previousLimit-10)), then raw limit-=10 regardless; else raw limit=currentHealth. This is a post-callback loss-retention overwrite, not an incoming damage cap/hurt gate, and it uses native setHealth bounds. Target snapshot is read once before phase controller. Nearest Player in full-side250 native box is selected BEFORE survival/adventure check; target-null arm may setTarget to this Player, but local attack snapshot remains null until next callback. Existing snapshot updates integer(truncated Euclidean) store_target_distance. At end creative/spectator or dead snapshot clears current Mob target with caught exception; that does not undo earlier attacks/aura. Native game-mode helpers use ServerPlayer gameMode, else client PlayerInfo when present. If any Player in250, nearest Player80 survival/adventure primes previously unprimed DATA_primed=true, creates visual-only lightning (no damage candidate), applies server Blindness60/1 to that nearest Player, then UI overlay via separate nearest reads. In-wall actor teleports to original callback X,Y+1,Z. Same Player250 presence invokes NULL-entity, suppressed permission4 command at original callback XYZ: fill +-3 arphex:cobweb_passable replace cobweb, with NO config or MobGriefing gate and ignored command return. Outside the alive block, Crawling dimension Y>250 teleports original callback X,Y-2,Z even if actor no longer alive. Native ServerPlayer connection branches cannot apply to concrete Monster. Overlay, particles, sounds and visual lightning are excluded from scalar observations.

Mode updates occur after attack arms and before local aura.
TimeFreeze query uses expansion before its update; native expansion not clamped.
Delayed Anchor chain checks low health only at third callback, no mode/alive recheck.
First Chrono direction zero remains native off and global cleanup is reused.
Damage request precedes actor invincibility skip and ignores hurt return.
Nearest Player selection precedes game-mode filter; local target snapshot remains stale after setTarget.
